sentences.en: He lacks consciousness that he is a member of society.
sentences.zh: 他缺乏自己是社会一员的意识。

sentences.en: When he regained consciousness, he was lying in the park.
sentences.zh: 当他恢复知觉时，发现自己躺在公园里。

sentences.en: Ten minutes after the knockout, the boxer regained consciousness.
sentences.zh: 拳击手被击倒十分钟后才恢复了意识。

senses.zh: 知觉 - 意识, 观念, 觉悟 - 察觉, 感觉

mnemonic: 词根记忆：conscious（有意识的）+ness （表名词）→意识
